scripts.dev: npm run sync-version && wxt -b chrome --mode development
scripts.build: npm run sync-version && wxt build -b chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run sync-version && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.build:edge: npm run sync-version && wxt build -b edge
scripts.zip: npm run sync-version && wxt zip -b chrome
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run sync-version && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.zip:edge: npm run sync-version && wxt zip -b edge
